$comment: Curated display names for Helix model identifiers. This is the only hand-maintained part of the catalogue: an identifier cannot tell you where '4x12' ends and '1960' begins, so a human who owns the device records it here. Everything else in packages/helix/src/model/catalogue.generated.ts is derived from presets by `pnpm helix:catalogue`, which merges this file in. Add entries as you confirm them against your own hardware or HX Edit, and leave a model out rather than guessing at it. Keys beginning with $ are ignored.

HD2_AmpEssexA30.label: Essex A30
HD2_AmpEssexA30.basedOn: the amp it emulates, as printed on the device
